profile.headline: HS Teacher. Previously SWE @ Google, LinkedIn, eBay, PayPal, PeopleSoft, RightWorks, Sun Microsystems.
profile.summary:
Seasoned software engineer with full-stack experience from infrastructure to platform, service and application development. Technical lead capable of designing and building highly available and scalable distributed systems. Reliable team member with a passion for delivering high quality work.

Languages: Python, Java, Bash
Cloud Computing: Virtualization, OpenStack Compute Network Storage, Docker, Kubernetes
Configuration Management: Puppet, SaltStack, Hiera, Fabric
Logging & Monitoring: Zabbix, Prometheus, ElasticSearch, Logstash, Kibana
Tools: Maven, JUnit, Jenkins, Git, Gerrit, SVN, Eclipse, PyCharm, Visual Studio Code, CI/CD
Design: Distributed Systems, Object-Oriented Design, Design Patterns, Data Modeling

- Improved search testing infrastructure reliability. 
- Attained Go readability.

positions.title: Voluntary work
positions.description: - Volunteered at The Bay Area Second Harvest Food Bank and Santa Clara Catholic Charities

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer (Developer Experience & Productivity)
positions.description:
- Technical lead responsible for critical and highly scalable distributed systems that powered the CI/CD pipeline. These services consistently attained the highest rating in terms of developers’ happiness and satisfaction. Provided technical guidance, coaching and mentorship to team members. Developed the roadmap and set priorities for the team. Spearheaded the adoption of agile methodology to improve the team’s productivity and collaboration.

- Improved build reliability by more than 20% which, in turn, increased developers’ productivity and happiness. Worked across teams and dozens of microservices to ensure build failures were accurately categorized and actionable. It resulted in a significant reduction in the time engineers spent debugging their builds. Implemented real-time monitoring of the CI pipeline which enabled early detection and prompt remediation of infrastructure issues. 

- Championed a culture of craftsmanship with a focus on code review, unit testing, and automation.
positions.insights: Skills: Agile Methodologies · Kibana · ElasticSearch · System Automation · Object Oriented Design · Python · Agile Methodolgy · Bash · SOA · Git · Web Services · Logstash · Docker · Scalability · Distributed Systems · Linux · Software Development · DevOps · Tomcat · Software Engineering

positions.title: Software Engineer MTS2 (Cloud Engineering)
positions.description:
- Led the implementation of a configuration management system that enabled one of the biggest deployments of OpenStack. The automation provided by this system shortened the time-to-market of new cloud deployments, reduced operating cost, and empowered a small team to manage large-scale OpenStack clusters.

- Implemented a fully automated system that monitored the entire stack, collecting millions of metrics per second. It enabled early detection of problems, reduced time to recovery when problems occurred, and ensured high availability of eBay’s cloud services.

- Authored an innovative system that collected logs and generated hundreds of metrics that were critical to the operation of eBay’s cloud, and relied upon by developers, operators and product managers.

- Founding member of cluster management team, which sought to enable large-scale deployments of Docker containers via Kubernetes.

positions.title: Software Engineer MTS2 (Platform Frameworks)
positions.description:
- Implemented the next generation of application development platform. Transformed the way developers created, built and deployed applications. Created a streamlined end-to-end experience for eBay developers, resulting in shorter ramp-up time, quicker time-to-market, and increased productivity overall.

- Developed an engine that orchestrated asynchronous tasks. This feature enabled parallel rendering of UI components as they became available, which resulted in faster response for end users.

- Led the project to create a batch framework that enabled long-running applications.

positions.title: Software Engineer MTS2 (Platform)
positions.description:
- Led a technical team to create a gadget framework in Java that allowed Third-party applications to be securely embedded on PayPal site, and thereby made available to PayPal’s merchants and consumers functionalities beyond PayPal’s core competency. Developed major components of the system including the database access layer, service interfaces, and security. 

- Contributed to the effort to enable large-scale development at PayPal using Java technologies. Thanks to its ease of use and the adoption of open source software, the Java stack became the platform of choice, and was quickly and widely adopted by development teams across PayPal. 

- Led the implementation of the Point of Sale (POS) feature, which enabled PayPal as a payment method at local stores. This feature was critical to the effort to extend PayPal’s footprint beyond the web.
positions.insights: Skills: Agile Methodologies · Spring · Object Oriented Design · Agile Methodolgy · SOA · Git · Web Services · Scalability · Java · Distributed Systems · Software Development · Maven · JUnit · Tomcat · Eclipse · Software Engineering

positions.title: Software Engineer MTS1 (Attributes & Catalog)
positions.description:
- Implemented critical components of the Pre-filled Item Specifics system, which made it easier and quicker for sellers to list items for sale, and improved search efficiency and relevance.

- Worked with many content providers to import millions of catalog products into eBay, which enabled product-based shopping experience such as rating and reviews and best selling products. These features enhanced the buying experience for eBay users, and led to higher conversion rates. 

- Key contributor in the redesign on the half.com system using eBay technologies and infrastructures. This project consolidated the operations of half.com site, and saved eBay millions of dollars in annual operating costs.
positions.insights: Skills: Agile Methodologies · Spring · Object Oriented Design · Agile Methodolgy · SOA · Git · Web Services · Scalability · Java · Distributed Systems · Software Development · JUnit · Tomcat · Eclipse · Perl · Software Engineering

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Implemented the Approval Workflow engine for the enterprise eProcurement product in PowerTier EJB application server. 

- Participated in the internationalization of Rightworks’ eProcurement product. Implemented multi-currency functionality and provided support for UTF-8 character set in the whole product.
positions.insights: Skills: Object Oriented Design · Software Development · Software Engineering

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: - Involved in the design, implementation and unit testing of the multi-threaded application server in C++.
